data.title: Bußgeldbescheid (fine notice) for speeding – Landkreis Musterammerland
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle of Landkreis Musterammerland issued a fine notice to Fenja Musterwolde for driving 18 km/h over the 30 km/h limit near a primary school on 23 September 2026. The total amount due is €147.00, and an objection (Einspruch) can be filed within two weeks of delivery, which the Postzustellungsurkunde shows occurred on 23 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine (Bußgeldbescheid) for a speeding offence. You can either pay the amount or file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle if you disagree. The app will show the objection deadline, calculated from the delivery date shown on the returned Zustellungsurkunde. If you do nothing, the fine becomes legally final and must then be paid within two weeks of that happening; unpaid fines can lead to enforcement action. Consider getting legal advice if you want to contest the facts or the speed measurement.

remedy.period_text: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
remedy.form_text: Der Einspruch ist beim Landkreis Musterammerland – Bußgeldstelle schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
remedy.quote: Sie können gegen den Bußgeldbescheid Einspruch einlegen.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Einspruch) to the fine
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection with the Bußgeldstelle, or let the fine become final and pay it.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed by the deadline shown, the fine becomes legally final (Rechtskraft) and enforceable.

date.text: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.

items.action: If you do not object, pay the total amount by bank transfer to the given IBAN once the decision becomes legally final.
items.consequence: Late or missed payment can lead to enforcement measures (Vollstreckung).
